shortDescription: KINDER MORGAN'S NYSE:KMI TENNESSEE GAS PIPELINE:

children: DECLARES FORCE MAJEURE AT SECTIONS 313A-403 TO 313A-404 ON THE HC LINE JUST SOUTH OF AVOCA, NEW YORK EFFECTIVE SEPT 16
SAYS AN ANOMALY HAS BEEN DISCOVERED WHICH REQUIRES IMMEDIATE REPAIRS
SAYS TENNESSEE PERSONNEL ARE ON SITE AND HAVE BEGUN WORKING A REPAIR PLAN TO BEGIN ON WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 16, 2026
SAYS IT IS ESTIMATING THE IMPACT OF THIS WORK TO BE UP TO 590,000 DTHS PATHED THROUGH MLV 313 HC ZONE 4 END (SEGMENT 399 FH)
SAYS BASED ON CURRENT OPERATING CONDITIONS, THE REPAIR WORK IS ESTIMATED TO LAST 4 DAYS

title: Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co Declares Force Majeure At Sections 313A-403 To 313A-404
